name: draw-tionary

scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && npm run smoke && npm run schema && npm run e2e
scripts.//dev: Same as start, but reads .env. Hosts inject real environment variables, so --env-file must not be in `start` — the file doesn't exist there.
scripts.//doctor: Read-only. Asks Discord what the bot was actually granted, per channel, and prints it.

//engines: node:sqlite is what bot/store.js runs on. It arrived in 22 and is still experimental, so pin the major rather than letting a host pick a newer one.
